newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-SUPER 12 LOOKS AT ADDING TWO TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SUPER 12 LOOKS AT ADDING TWO TEAMS.

text.p: Two more teams could join the Super 12 southern hemisphere provincial rugby union competition in 2000, organising body SANZAR said on Tuesday.
The SANZAR board, representing the Australian, New Zealand and South African rugby unions, has agreed to conduct a feasibility study into the proposed expansion.
New Zealand has five teams, including champions Auckland, in the Super 12. South Africa has four and Australia three.
Both South Africa and Australia are pressing for another place each.
In a statement issued on Tuesday, SANZAR said it would discuss the financial viability of the changes with media tycoon Rupert Murdoch's News Ltd, which owns broadcasting rights for the competition.
